name: 진군의 뿔피리
subject: A SHORT, THICK curved medieval blowing HORN made of warm IVORY, with a big flared bell opening and a stubby stout mouthpiece. Compact crescent/J-shaped silhouette, broad tapering body, not a long skinny trumpet. View the broad bell at a slight angle so its dark recessed oval mouth and thick rounded rim are clearly visible. Hollow mouth is opaque charcoal/tan shadow, not transparent. One chunky golden collar near the bell, large ivory body plane and one pale tan shadow along the inside curve. No straps, cords, holes along the body, musical notes or ornamental carving. Make the horn opening unmistakable; do not draw a crescent blade, banana, bread roll, cup or ordinary animal horn without an opening.

name: 비전의 등불
subject: A squat fantasy LANTERN containing violet magic. Thick rounded GOLD metal cap and broad foot, with one large plump PURPLE GLASS chamber between them. Rounded rectangle/octagonal body in very slight three-quarter view, two sturdy short frame sides rather than a delicate cage. A small SOLID golden knob on the top, no arch handle or long loop. The broad purple window and one dark mauve side plane are filled opaque glass, with one small pale lilac magic-light shape INSIDE it. No external aura, floating particles, candle stem, flame, electric bulb, chains, thin bars or filigree. It must read as a chunky physical lantern, distinct from an incense burner, jar, potion flask or hourglass. The main body should occupy most of the icon.

name: 순풍의 향낭
subject: One plump GREEN CLOTH SACHET, broad rounded weighted bottom, softly uneven shoulders and a short gathered neck tied with a thick warm-tan band. A tiny fan of folded cloth above the tie, no long strings, ribbon tails or loose fibers. One large forest-green shadow fold and a little light-green folded plane show soft cloth, no many stripes. On the broad green front one simple small cream LEAF-shaped fabric patch, without lettering or fine veins. Slight diagonal natural stance, gentle full silhouette, a substantial comforting little fabric pouch rather than a bottle, handbag, cape or sprouting plant. No extra decorations, sparkle or wind streaks.

name: 결사의 투구
subject: One stout battle-worn medieval knight HELMET, slightly turned in three-quarter view. Broad rounded steel crown and forehead plate, deep CHARCOAL horizontal eye slit and one strong short nose guard. Thick cheek guards and a flat substantial lower edge form a compact armored head shape without a wearer. The visor is filled dark charcoal, not transparent cutout holes. One obvious small chipped corner on one side of the brow shows damage, not an elaborate web of cracks. A SHORT THICK RED crest/ridge sits on top: one block of red cloth/hair, no long thin plume or individual feather hairs. Pale silver front plane and blue-gray side plane, one modest pale top plane. No horns, glowing eyes, skull, blood, detached fragments, chains or filigree. Make a resolute physical helmet, distinct from the earlier plain face mask and from a whole breastplate.
